Ever wonder if secret societies are influencing The Chosen? In this eye-opening documentary, we explore Jonathan Roumie’s ties to groups like the Knights Templars, Freemasons, and the Jesuits, uncovering their possible impact on his portrayal of Jesus. Discover how it all connects to Bible prophecy and why it matters for believers today.
